title: The WhataHotel Take: Four Seasons Maui at Wailea

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.text: Four Seasons Maui at Wailea is a Forbes Five-Star resort on Wailea Beach. The thing to understand is that it's in the middle of a big transformation.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.text: Which cuts both ways. We'll get to that.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.text: Start with the beach. Wailea Beach was No. 4 on Dr. Beach's 2026 list. The U-shaped building gives most rooms Pacific views, and there's the adults-only Serenity Pool, infinity edge, underwater music.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.text: And you don't have to leave for dinner.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.text: Not at all. Spago, open-air Ferraro's, and KOMO, a Japanese spot with a 14-seat sushi bar. Plus the new Kai Holo Spa with hydrotherapy pools and a cold plunge.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.text: Families with kids five and up, since Kids For All Seasons is complimentary daily. Couples too. And winter whale watchers, the humpback peak is January to March.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.text: Here's the catch. Guest rooms are being renovated, reportedly finishing around mid-December 2026. An autumn stay may coincide with construction, so confirm room status.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.text: Fair. And entry-level rooms face the mountain, so ocean views mean a higher category.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.text: Bottom line: for beach-loving families and couples, especially in whale season, it's a strong pick. Just time it around the renovation.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, you get free breakfast for two daily, a priority upgrade if available at check-in, and a $100 hotel credit.

short_version.best_for: Families with kids 5+, couples and winter whale watchers
short_version.atmosphere: Full-service oceanfront resort on Wailea Beach with three saline pools
short_version.worth_knowing: Guest-room renovation through about mid-December 2026; ocean views need a higher room category
